results.title: Karim Zito sacked over inconsistent results and disunity among backroom staff – AshantiGold CEO
results.content: AshantiGold have made a mixed start to the 2026/27 Ghana Premier League campaign, recording three wins in their opening eight matches.

results.title: Petrol prices tipped to fall from Nov. 1 as diesel floor rises
results.content: Petrol prices could fall at the pump from November 1, 2026, while diesel prices may rise marginally after the National Petroleum Authority (NPA) adjusts its price floors.

results.title: Woman killed by Tema-Afienya train as residents demand footbridge
results.content: An unidentified woman has been killed after being struck by a passenger train on the Tema-Afienya railway line at Mataheko-Sebrepo, prompting residents to renew calls for a footbridge to provide a safer crossing between communities in the area.

results.title: AMA clears Achimota bus stop to make way for Ayalolo buses
results.content: The Accra Metropolitan Assembly (AMA) has stepped up efforts to reclaim public spaces in the capital, clearing unauthorised structures around the Achimota New Overhead Ayalolo bus stop to improve access for commercial buses and their passengers.

results.title: Dr. Bawumia engages TUC leadership on youth employment, rising living costs and labour welfare
results.content: Former Vice President and NPP presidential candidate, Dr. Mahamudu Bawumia, has taken his broad-based stakeholder engagement to Organised Labour, meeting with the leadership of the Trades Union Congress (TUC) at the Hall of Trade Unions in Accra Tuesday. The meeting, held as part of Dr. Bawumia's ongoing national consultations, brought together top executives of the TUC, the umbrella body representing thousands of Ghanaian workers across both the public and private sectors.

results.title: CDD-Ghana urges NDC to crack down on vote-buying
results.content: The Centre for Democratic Development Ghana (CDD-Ghana) has urged the National Democratic Congress (NDC) to introduce clear rules and stronger monitoring systems to address allegations of vote-buying in its internal elections.

results.title: Stop using money to manipulate elections — Inusah Fuseini warns vote-buying politicians
results.content: Former Tamale Central Member of Parliament Inusah Fuseini has cautioned against the growing use of money to influence internal party elections, saying financial inducements threaten electoral integrity even when they fail to determine the eventual winner.

results.title: Northern Ashanti Mines challenges Minerals Commission over Konongo takeover, disputes $8.3m debt
results.content: Northern Ashanti Mines Limited (NAML) has challenged the Minerals Commission’s justification for taking over its Konongo premises, accusing the regulator of making false claims about its debt and mining activities.

results.title: Cenpower clears 600 tonnes of waste from Sega Beach
results.content: Cenpower Generation Ltd says it removed 600 tonnes of waste from Sega Beach during the fourth edition of its annual KIPP Clean Project, highlighting the scale of shoreline pollution.

results.title: Vote-buying: NDC weighs rules to distinguish transport payments from electoral inducement
results.content: The National Democratic Congress (NDC) is weighing rules to determine when money given to delegates for transport becomes an electoral inducement.

results.title: Senanu questions NDC’s commitment to tackling vote-buying
results.content: Anti-corruption campaigner Edem Senanu has criticised the National Democratic Congress (NDC) leadership for what he considers an inadequate response to allegations of vote-buying during the party’s recent constituency executive elections, warning that the handling of the matter risks damaging the party’s image and ethical standing.

results.title: Oil prices rise after attack on Saudi Arabian refinery reignites supply concerns
results.content: Oil prices rose on Wednesday after an attack on a refinery in Saudi Arabia, the ​world's biggest crude exporter, renewed concerns around the ‌risks to supply in the Middle East stemming from the conflict with Iran and its proxies.

results.title: Dangote refinery IPO draws three times target demand, sources say
results.content: Nigeria's $1.6 billion Dangote refinery initial ‌public offering has drawn about three times the total targeted orders, two people with knowledge of the situation said, underscoring strong demand for what has been billed as "The People's IPO".

results.title: Nigeria’s president seeks parliament approval for about $21.7bn borrowing
results.content: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu has asked the National Assembly to approve a supplementary external borrowing plan worth $20.52 billion and €1.05 billion ($1.17 billion) for 2026-2027 to fund infrastructure and other projects.

results.title: Tanzania announces first gas discovery in more than 10 years
results.content: Tanzania has discovered an estimated 223 billion cubic feet of natural gas in the Mnazi Bay area in the country's south, its energy minister announced on Tuesday.

results.title: Vote-buying: High cost of politics is pricing out people with integrity – Inusah Fuseini
results.content: Former Tamale Central MP Inusah Fuseini says the growing cost of politics is pushing people with integrity out of public life and fuelling corruption.

results.title: Russell Brand told police he never had non-consensual sex
results.content: Russell Brand told police in interviews in response to allegations of rape and sexual assault that he had been "very promiscuous" in the past, but had never engaged in "non-consensual sexual activity", a court has heard.

results.title: GoldBod’s intervention in forex market gives cedi modest reprieve; one dollar going for GH¢12.15 at forex bureaus
results.content: By the close of the fortnight, the local currency modestly clawed back some losses in the interbank market.

results.title: Deaths in detention cells in Nigeria were entirely preventable, inquiry finds
results.content: An inquiry into the deaths of 33 detainees in Nigeria's Minna state has found they died as a result of severe overcrowding, poor ventilation and failure by officers to respond to distress calls.

results.title: Controversial Islamic cleric shot dead in northern Nigeria
results.content: A controversial Islamic cleric in Nigeria has been murdered outside his home in the northern state of Katsina.

results.title: La Pleasure Beach management sues SSNIT, two hotels over demolition
results.content: The dispute over the management of La Pleasure Beach has taken a legal turn, with the beach’s management committee suing two hotel companies and the Social Security and National Insurance Trust (SSNIT) over the demolition of its office and other structures.

results.title: Vote-buying: Heavy political spending fuels corruption – Inusah Fuseini
results.content: Former NDC MP for Tamale Central, Inusah Fuseini, has warned that heavy political spending fuels corruption as politicians seek to recover the money they spend to win power.

results.title: Luxury cruise passengers stranded in Cambodia due to soaring fuel costs
results.content: A luxury cruise ship on a years-long voyage around the world suspended operations because of extraordinarily high fuel costs, leaving passengers stranded in Cambodia.

results.title: ‘A politician is not an NGO’ – Inusah Fuseini on the cost of seeking office
results.content: Former NDC MP for Tamale Central, Inusah Fuseini, warned that politicians who spend heavily to win office expect to recoup their money, fuelling corruption nationwide.

results.title: Neil Young again sues Trump campaign for playing Rockin’ in the Free World at rally
results.content: Rock veteran Neil Young has filed a $10m lawsuit against a fundraising committee supporting US President Donald Trump, citing the "unauthorised" use of his 1989 song Rockin' in the Free World.

results.title: Defeated presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro arrives in US after Brazil cancels his passports
results.content: Defeated presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro has arrived in the US, hours after Brazil cancelled his passports, sources have told the BBC.

results.title: GPAA opens 23rd Annual Conference in Techiman with strong calls for primary healthcare action
results.content: The Ghana Physician Assistants Association (GPAA) has officially opened its 23rd Annual General Conference at the Jemima Grace Kodua Hotel in Techiman, with a resounding call for physician assistants to be positioned at the heart of Ghana's primary healthcare delivery system.

results.title: Former Miss Switzerland accuses Donald Trump of rape
results.content: Donald Trump has been accused of rape by a model and former Miss Switzerland in a report produced by the Democratic Party.

results.title: China’s families are now supporting more old people than kids
results.content: Families in China are now supporting more elderly people than children, the government has said.
